goldens.comment: The code attempts to access integration.metadata[sender][login] without checking for the existence of the sender key. This causes a KeyError for integrations where the sender metadata was not set during creation

candidates: OAuthLoginView.dispatch() accepts installation_id from GET params unconditionally at lines 397-399, even during the OAuth callback phase, allowing an attacker to craft a callback URL containing their own installation_id, code, and the predictable state value to overwrite both sides of the sender comparison and bypass sender verification

integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] at line 503 will raise a KeyError for pre-existing integrations that lack the sender key in their metadata, since build_integration only adds sender conditionally and other code paths already guard against this

The token exchange request at lines 427-431 is missing redirect_uri, but the authorize URL at line 408 explicitly includes it, violating RFC 6749 Section 4.1.3 which requires redirect_uri to be included in the token exchange request with an identical value if it was included in the authorization request
